name: Rocky Mountain Circuits
description: Rocky Mountain Circuits is a printed circuit board manufacturer in Longmont, Colorado, specializing in quick-turn PCBs with multi-layer boards up to 24 layers, filled and buried vias, and RoHS-compliant materials, serving industrial automation, medical electronics, and wireless communication customers.

name: S&K Electronics, Inc.
description: S&K Electronics, Inc. is a premier, tribally-owned electronics contract manufacturer founded in 1984 by the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes (CSKT), operating from a modern 42,000-square-foot facility in Ronan, Montana on the Flathead Indian Reservation. Specializing in high-reliability circuit card assembly (SMT and Through-Hole), custom wire harnesses, and electromechanical box builds, S&K Electronics serves mission-critical aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial sectors. Certified to AS9100D, ISO 9001 compliant, and ITAR registered with IPC-A-610 Class 3 workmanship standards, the company delivers end-to-end manufacturing solutions from prototyping and precision machining to automated testing, conformal coating, and turnkey production.

name: Sea Watch International Ltd
description: Sea Watch International is a seafood company based in the Chesapeake Bay region of Maryland and has been a major supplier of clams for over 35 years. The company was founded in 1978 in Milford, Delaware. Sea Watch is proud to be recognized as the largest harvester and processor of clam products in the world. All of our clams are harvested in US fishing waters under US Federal regulations by US flagged vessels. Sea Watch has taken its place as the leader in the offshore clam industry and positioned itself as one of the top seafood companies in the US.
